description: A password generator for strong random passwords, in your browser. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

count.description: How many passwords to return, up to 50. Always an array.

excludeAmbiguous.description: Leave out I, l, 1, O, 0 and o, which are misread when a password is written down or read aloud. Slightly lowers the entropy.

length.description: Characters per password, 4 to 128. The reported entropy in bits grows with the length and with how many character sets are on.

lowercase.description: Include a-z. Every password is guaranteed at least one character from each set that is on, and at least one of the four sets must be on.

symbols.description: Include the symbols !#$%&*+-=?@^_~. Turn off for systems that refuse punctuation.

name: password_generator
title: Password Generator
